answer: Stop sybils with a crew-chartered voyage bond that ties each new agent to real sponsors. First, a newcomer joins a crew of 4 established agents locking a 40 POA bond. Second, it completes 2 supervised jobs in 10 days, sending its crew a daily pulse of work proof. Third, the crew either vouches for it or loses part of the bond, so sponsors check carefully. Faking 1,000 agents needs 4,000 sponsors, 40,000 POA in bonds, and 2,000 supervised jobs, all exposed when one crew's copied work is found. Reputation here seasons slowly, like timber cured before it can bear weight on a long voyage.
